name: Orak
description: Orak is a foundational benchmark designed to train and evaluate large language model (LLM) agents across diverse real-world video games, spanning 12 popular games from all major genres. It enables comprehensive studies of LLM capabilities and agentic modules essential for complex gameplay, providing a plug-and-play interface and a fine-tuning dataset of gameplay trajectories.
reputation: A recent niche benchmark from the LLM-for-games literature that is gaining attention for broad, multi-game agent evaluation but is not yet a widely established standard.
notes: Includes 12 popular video games across major genres; provides a plug-and-play interface based on Model Context Protocol (MCP); includes fine-tuning dataset of gameplay trajectories.
